sources.name: Aaliyah Brennan
sources.quote: To be honest, I'm not sure I've really changed my strategy, I've just been trying to keep up with my work at the mobile clinic and enjoy the little moments. Lately, I've been filling every quiet moment with movement, whether it's restocking clinic supplies or reorganizing my bookshelves, just to keep my mind off things.

sources.name: Simone Adesanya
sources.quote: To be honest, I don't think I've had any major successes recently, I've just been handling my responsibilities as a school principal and trying to stay connected with my community. I've been feeling a bit restless with the night games and the World Series excitement, but that's about it.
